motivation: User requires a strictly mathematical CPU-only JANUS research theorem rather than hardware photons or statistical coincidences.

proven_claims.statement: If B is an independent uniform future bit and R is all information accessible to the algorithm before B, then for any early Boolean A=f(R), P(A=B)=1/2 and I(A;B)=0. For any early pair X,Z=g(R), P(X,Z|B)=P(X,Z).
proven_claims.formal_proof: For each x,z,b, P(X=x,Z=z,B=b)=sum_{r:g(r)=(x,z)} P(R=r,B=b) = sum_r P(R=r)P(B=b) = P(X=x,Z=z)/2.
assumptions: B independent of complete earlier information R
A,X,Z computed solely from R without leakage or a physical future-directed input
proven_claims.implication: Computational complexity, neural networks and quantum emulation do not generate knowledge of B while these assumptions hold.

proven_claims.formalism: Oreshkov-Costa-Brukner generalized process matrices; local CP maps and generalized Born rule
proven_claims.pauli_process: P=IZZI, Q=ZIXZ, W(v) = [I + (v/sqrt(2))*(P+Q)]/4, tensor order A_in A_out B_in B_out
exact_properties: W(v) has eigenvalues (1±v)/4 each multiplicity 8 for 0≤v≤1
For any local CPTP Choi maps, Tr W(M_A tensor M_B)=1, due partial trace identities
proven_claims.exact_Born_probability: P(x,y|a,b,task)=1/4 + ((-1)^(x XOR b) if task=0, else (-1)^(y XOR a)) * v*sqrt(2)/8
proven_claims.causal_bound_argument: With a definite A before B or B before A, one of two equally likely games must guess an independent unavailable bit (success <=1/2), while the favorable direction can succeed <=1. Convex mixtures retain <=3/4.
proven_claims.proof_of_sign: sqrt(2)>1 because 2>1 and both terms positive
proven_claims.exact_field: Q(sqrt(2)), coefficient pairs of Fraction objects, no float or stochastic sampling
proven_claims.result: There exists a mathematically valid noncausally-ordered process W in the generalized process-matrix theory, incompatible with any convex mixture of definite causal orders.
proven_claims.physical_scope_limit: Existence in generalized mathematical model is not proof of implementation by standard time-ordered physical circuits or of messages to a clock-attested earlier receiver.

proven_claims.premises: X,Z,B all independent fair bits, 8 joint outcomes P=1/8 each
proven_claims.filter: Retain event only when B=X XOR Z
proven_claims.conditional_joint: After renormalization of retained events, P(X,Z,B)=1/4 on parity-equal outcomes and zero otherwise — identical to ideal parity-jamming toy's selected joint distribution.
proven_claims.conclusion: A mathematically perfect later-conditioned correlation is not proof that later intervention changed already committed earlier data.

new_implementation.canonical_cpu_technique: Exact rational Pauli 16x16 contractions and algebraic field Q(sqrt2)
